title: Franchise Mix of All Signature: Reading Paths Overview
body:
Signature fiction — unofficial reading paths, not affiliated with or endorsed by any rights holder. This Signature edition gives one reading path per franchise: the order of its eleven Signature sequel stories, each complete in itself.

Paths are suggestions only. Because every Signature story ends its own arc, any path can be entered at any point.

print("Franchise Mix of All Signature | reading paths")
print("Paths: 12")

Paths: 12

title: Harry Potter Signature Reading Path
body:

Read in this order: Maren Ellery and the Clockwork Tide; Maren Ellery and the Glass Compass; Maren Ellery and the Silent Archive; Maren Ellery and the Ember Charter; Maren Ellery and the Hollow Lighthouse; Maren Ellery and the Map of Unmade Roads; Maren Ellery and the Winter Market; Maren Ellery and the Stone Choir; Maren Ellery and the Paper Fleet; Maren Ellery and the Lantern Accord; Maren Ellery and the Thirteenth Door.
